facts.big: used to + verbo (did you use to…?)
facts.label: Hábitos do passado com used to
facts.sub: Afirmativa: I used to live here. Pergunta: Did you use to live here? Negativa: I didn’t use to live here. Depois de did e didn’t, escreva use to, sem o d.

facts.label: Costumava
facts.sub: Use used to + verbo base para hábitos e situações do passado que não existem mais: I used to live here. Não é para algo que aconteceu uma só vez, e sim para algo que se repetia ou durou.

facts.label: Perguntas
facts.sub: Para perguntar, use did + subject + use to: Did you use to live here? Aqui o used perde o d, porque did já mostra o passado. A resposta curta é Yes, I did ou No, I didn’t.

compare.br: No Brasil, usamos o imperfeito: “Eu morava aqui”, “Eu comprava pão”.
compare.us: Em inglês, use used to + verbo: I used to live here. Em perguntas e negativas, use use to: Did you use to…?

pages.title: An old street · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold Saturday morning in Liverpool. Joe walks along a street he knows well. He stops in front of a new bank. Luisa comes out of the shop next door. They have lived near here for many years. Joe starts to talk about the past.
“Luisa, did you use to live on this street?” says Joe. “Yes, I did. I used to live next to the old bakery.” says Luisa. “Really? Did you use to buy bread there every morning?” says Joe.
